title: ApiSettings
description: config/api.yaml: where api-server listens, its database pool, and the limits of its requests and event streams (ADR-0018). The token is SYNTH_API_TOKEN, never written here.

listen.description: The socket address to bind, as host:port.

request_timeout_ms.description: How long a request other than an event stream may take.

artifact_root.description: The directory artifact files are read from: the artifact volume (ADR-0016). A relative path is taken from the working directory.

keep_alive_ms.description: How often an idle event stream sends a comment, so proxies keep it open.

page_size.description: How many events one read of the log returns at most.
